channel.title: Hartford Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hartford Business Journal (hartfordbusiness.com)

item.title: 🔒 Following Halda Therapeutics deal, CI banks $41M in 2Q venture proceeds
item.description: Connecticut Innovations (CI), the state’s quasi-public venture capital arm, said Wednesday it generated about $41 million in returns during the second quarter of its fiscal year, which ended Dec. 31 — a sharp increase from $7 million in the first quarter.

item.title: Hartford HealthCare cancer program earns new designation in MSK partnership
item.description: Hartford HealthCare’s Cancer Institute has been designated an “MSK Care Partner” by Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, a move the organizations say formalizes clinical standards already in place through a long-running affiliation.

item.title: Update of Hartford’s underground loop heating system on hold
item.description: A contentious plan to heat state office buildings in downtown Hartford with a new generation of gas-powered boilers is on hold due to potential interference from the planned reconstruction of Interstate 84, officials confirmed this week.

item.title: Out-of-state investor buys Derby Shopping Center for $15.4M
item.description: A Michigan-based commercial real estate investment firm has purchased the Derby Shopping Center for $15.35 million.

item.title: Mass. decorative stone company owner buys Windsor industrial building
item.description: An industrial warehouse in Windsor has sold for $995,000 to the owner of a Massachusetts-based decorative brick and stone veneer supplier.

item.title: CBIA sets 10 ‘policy solutions’ for state legislators to help small businesses
item.description: The Connecticut Business & Industry Association on Thursday released a package of state policy recommendations it says are aimed at strengthening small businesses and reshaping the state’s economy.

item.title: 🔒 Hair-loss drug developer Veradermics plans $182M stock offering
item.description: Veradermics Inc., the New Haven drug developer working on an oral treatment for hair loss, said it expects to raise about $181.8 million in its planned initial public offering.

item.title: Stamford law firm launches free app for tracking CT court cases
item.description: Silver Golub & Teitell LLP has released a free application that allows attorneys and the public to monitor Connecticut court case activity in near real time.

item.title: Dubai fugitive detained after allegedly fleecing CT lender for years
item.description: A Dubai resident faces federal charges for allegedly defrauding a Connecticut-based commercial lender out of hundreds of thousands of dollars as part of a nationwide scheme targeting small business loans.

item.title: Cigna exec: No single player can solve U.S. health care affordability crisis
item.description: Brian Evanko, president and chief operating officer of The Cigna Group, says solving the growing health care affordability crisis will require the combined efforts of all stakeholders.
